name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.6 Instant After Effects 1-Click Addition & Zero API Setup!
• Instant Double-Click Insert: Double-clicking ANY card (emojis, icons, local files) immediately inserts it into your active After Effects Composition and Icons bin with 0 extra clicks!
• Quick [+] Button: Hovering on any asset card now displays a [+] quick-insert button for instant 1-click placement.
• Clean Settings (Zero API Setup): Removed the API key section from Settings. All 200,000+ icons and emojis work 100% free and unlocked through public open CDNs without needing any keys or configuration!
• Drag & Drop Clarification: Premiere Pro supports direct timeline dragging; for After Effects (which restricts panel drag), double-click or [+] provides instant one-action insertion.
• Storage & Cache Controls: Full zero-disk previewing and Settings cache cleaner.
